name: Fairy Rune ~Yume no Naka de~
original_name: フェアリー・ルーン ～夢の中で～
source:
One day you have a very peculiar dream.
You are the tiny-sized lover of a fairy...
It's so specific that you don't know if it's real or not.

In fact, that reality is up to you.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ076723.html]DLsite English[/url]]
